purpose.zh: 拉伸臀部，缓解久坐髋部紧张
purpose.en: Stretch your glutes and ease hip tightness from sitting.

text.zh: 脚踝搭在对侧膝上，背部拉长向前折
text.en: Cross your ankle over the other knee and fold forward with a long back

text.zh: 支撑脚踩平，膝盖自然向外打开
text.en: Keep the standing foot flat and let the crossed knee fall open.

text.zh: 臀部有拉伸感就停住，慢慢呼吸
text.en: Stop where you feel your glute stretch and breathe slowly.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to go deeper.
Forcing the knee down with your hand.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减小前倾幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Lean less if your knee hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
